concept: Palm Supporting a Soft Lobed Shape
description: A horizontal hand extends from the left with its palm facing upward and rounded fingertips pointing right. Above it floats a soft three-lobed shape, accompanied by two short curved motion marks.

concept: Pointing Finger with a Falling Drop
description: A hand points to the right with a long extended index finger and an upturned thumb. The remaining fingers curl into the palm, while a teardrop hangs beneath the fingertip.

concept: Two Columns Beneath a Width Arrow
description: Two upright rectangular columns sit side by side, each divided horizontally into two cells. A long double-headed horizontal arrow spans above them, with its tips pointing outward.

concept: Spinal Column with Three Paired Processes
description: A thick upright central column has rounded upper and lower ends. Three matching pairs of rounded lateral projections extend from its sides at evenly spaced heights.

concept: Rounded Machine Frame with a Gear
description: A tall rounded frame stands on a broad low base and encloses a smaller open inner frame. A toothed gear with a circular center overlaps the frame's lower-right side and a horizontal interior ledge.

concept: Padded Infant Car Seat
description: A deep infant seat has a rounded high back surrounded by a thick protective rim. Curved padded sections and a central dividing line converge toward the bottom, between broad raised side supports.

concept: Person with Head Bandage and Arm Sling
description: A round-headed bust has a diagonal bandage across the forehead. One bent arm rests inside a broad triangular sling suspended from the neck, while the opposite shoulder curves down at the right.

concept: Veiled Head Beneath a Domed Cap
description: A rounded cap with a straight lower edge sits above a plain U-shaped face outline. Two long sloping veil edges descend on either side, separated from the cap by small gaps.

concept: Knotted Triangular Neck Bandana
description: A pointed triangular cloth hangs below a broad curved upper fold. At the top, a small central knot joins two pointed ends that spread diagonally upward to the left and right.

concept: Lower Leg Resting in a Support
description: A cropped lower leg descends into a rounded heel above a left-facing foot. Horizontal support lines surround the foot, with a lower rail curving upward at the right.

concept: Low Oval Bread Loaf
description: A broad loaf has a gently domed top, rounded ends, and a flat lower edge. Three curved scoring marks descend from the upper outline across the left and middle portions.

concept: Two-Wheel Cart with a Marked Suitcase
description: A luggage cart has a tall curved handle on the left and a low horizontal platform above two round wheels. A broad suitcase with a top handle and two short face marks rests on it.

concept: Traveler Reaching Toward a Conveyor Bag
description: A round-headed person leans forward from the left with a bent arm extended toward a suitcase. The handled bag sits above the rounded left end of a horizontal conveyor belt.

concept: Strapped Suitcase Above a Conveyor
description: A broad rounded suitcase has a raised top handle and two vertical bands across its face. It sits just above a horizontal conveyor with a rounded return curve on the left.

concept: Plain Suitcase on a Curved-Handle Trolley
description: A simple handled suitcase rests on a trolley's flat platform. The trolley frame curves upward into a tall handle at left, with two small round wheels separated below the base.

concept: Trolley Carrying Two Unequal Bags
description: A trolley carries a short handled suitcase beside a taller upright bag with a lower band. Its frame rises into a curved handle on the left, and two wheels sit below the long platform.

concept: Banded Suitcase on a Raised Dial Scale
description: A small suitcase with two vertical bands rests above a wide weighing platform. A tall post on the right supports a circular dial, whose short pointer has a small enclosed base.

concept: Suitcase Below a Floating Round Gauge
description: A compact suitcase with a top handle and two horizontal face marks stands on a thin baseline. A large circular gauge with a diagonal pointer floats directly above it.

concept: Diagonal Bacterium with Two Inner Circles
description: A rounded capsule-shaped bacterium tilts from lower left to upper right. Short straight projections radiate from its edge, and two small circular inclusions lie along its central length.

concept: Woman Standing Beside a Baby Carriage
description: A small standing figure with curved hair and a flared dress appears at left. A round-bodied baby carriage with an upright hood and two tiny wheels stands separately to her right.

concept: Twin Peaks Inside a Rounded Hill Emblem
description: A broad rounded hill outline encloses two angular mountain peaks of unequal height. Their sloping sides meet the curved lower boundary, joining the inner landscape to the outer shape.

concept: Nose Poised Above an Open Palm
description: A large nose appears in side profile above an upward-facing hand. The hand extends from a rectangular cuff on the left, with a curved palm and raised fingertip pointing right.

concept: Person Seated at a Straight Desk
description: A round-headed person sits behind a long horizontal tabletop with one bent arm resting on it. A curved seated thigh and downward-bent lower leg are visible between the table's two straight legs.

concept: Standing Person Wearing an Arm Sling
description: A round head sits above a broad torso with one arm hanging down. The other arm bends across the chest, supported by a triangular sling whose strap rises to the opposite shoulder.

concept: Resealable Pouch with a Wide Top Seal
description: An upright rectangular pouch has straight sides, softly rounded bottom corners, and a flat top edge. A horizontal seam near the top forms a broad sealed band across its plain face.

concept: Rounded Backpack with Side Pockets
description: A tall rounded backpack has a small top handle and two projecting side pockets. A broad front pocket sits low on the body, with a straight horizontal seam across its upper portion.

concept: Capped Service Worker in an Apron
description: A round-headed bust wears a domed cap with a curved band. Two straight apron straps frame the neck and join a rounded bib with a short horizontal mark on its front.

concept: Round Baby Carriage with Raised Hood
description: A circular carriage body rises into a tall upright hood on the right, leaving a squared opening at upper left. A curved handle extends leftward above two detached round wheels.

concept: Plain Round Bagel
description: A broad circular bagel surrounds a smaller centered round hole. Both outlines are smooth and uninterrupted, leaving an even ring of dough with no additional surface markings.

concept: Open Circular Bangle
description: A plain circular bracelet follows a smooth single outline around an empty center. A small gap interrupts the lower-right edge, leaving two separated ends along the curve.

concept: Plain Head Below a Rounded Brimmed Hat
description: A semicircular hat crown rests on a long straight brim. Beneath it, a broad U-shaped face outline remains separated from the brim at both sides, with no interior facial features.

concept: Six Rounded Upright Modules
description: Six upright rounded rectangles form two evenly spaced rows of three. Their matching proportions and aligned edges create a balanced modular grid with open gaps between all the shapes.

concept: Heart with a Curved Smile
description: A broad heart has two rounded upper lobes and a shallow central notch above a pointed base. A single upward-opening smile curve sits centrally inside the otherwise empty outline.

concept: Smiling Woman with Shoulder-Length Hair
description: A front-facing woman has shoulder-length hair framing a plain oval face with tiny eyes and a curved smile. The hair sweeps into a pointed part above the forehead and curves beside the neck.

concept: Avalanche Beside a Steep Mountain Slope
description: A steep mountain descends diagonally toward the lower right, with a curved snow contour crossing its face. Two round falling masses and short diagonal motion strokes sit beyond the upper-right slope.

concept: Bearded Pirate Behind a Laptop
description: A bearded figure wears a broad lobed pirate hat marked with a small cross. An open laptop screen tilts in the foreground, obscuring the lower-left portion of the face and body.

concept: Angular Three-Feather Shuttlecock
description: A rounded cork base sits at the lower left of a diagonally tilted shuttlecock. Three long angular feather panels fan toward the upper right, ending at a stepped outer edge.

concept: Steak Beside a Curled Shrimp
description: A broad irregular steak has a circular interior bone near its left side. A segmented shrimp curls above and to the right, with its open inner curve facing toward the steak.

concept: Two Price Bars with Opposing Ticks
description: Two thin upright bars stand side by side at unequal heights. Each carries one short tick extending left and another extending right, placed at different levels along the vertical line.

concept: Stork Holding a Tied Bundle
description: A long-necked stork faces right with a narrow pointed beak and tiny eye. The beak holds a knot with two leaf-shaped loops, from which a large teardrop bundle hangs.

concept: Round-Headed Baby in a Diagonal Wrap
description: A broad circular baby head occupies the upper portion of a rounded swaddle. The blanket curves around the head and crosses diagonally over the lower body, ending in a smooth rounded base.

concept: Hooded Swaddle with Crossed Blanket Folds
description: An upright capsule-shaped swaddle surrounds a round face opening near its top. Two diagonal blanket edges cross beneath the face and span the rounded lower body.

concept: Diagonal Bandolier with Cartridge Loops
description: A broad rounded belt runs diagonally from lower left to upper right. Four adjacent cartridge-loop shapes project along one side, separated by short angled seams across the strap.

concept: Basketball with Curved Side Seams
description: A round basketball is divided by a vertical and a horizontal seam crossing at its center. Two inward-curving side seams bow between the upper and lower edges of the ball.

concept: Woman with a Hair Bun and Crossed Collar
description: A front-facing woman wears her hair in a rounded bun above a center-parted fringe. Broad shoulders sit beneath a high neck, and two diagonal collar bands overlap across the chest.

concept: Head Wearing a Tall Flat-Topped Hat
description: A tall rectangular hat crown rests on a straight brim extending beyond both sides. Beneath the brim, a plain oval-ended face descends smoothly with no additional facial details.

concept: Three Balloons with Hanging Strings
description: Three teardrop-shaped balloons overlap, with the center balloon raised above the side pair. A straight central string and two gently curling side strings hang from their pointed lower knots.

concept: Woman Explorer with a Brimmed Hat
description: A front-facing explorer wears a tall banded hat above a plain face and outward-flaring hair. A rounded neckline and two backpack straps descend between broad shoulder outlines.

concept: Head Wrapped in a Face Veil
description: A rounded head covering has a straight forehead band above a wide uncovered face strip. A large curved veil wraps across the lower face and shoulder, with a short internal fold line.

concept: Beach Lounger Beneath a Tilted Parasol
description: A broad semicircular parasol tilts above a long flat sun lounger. Its straight pole meets the lounger near the center, while angled legs and a raised backrest extend from the chair's ends.

concept: Beach Parasol Beside a Low Sun
description: A segmented parasol stands on a tilted pole above a curved shoreline. A horizontal horizon crosses behind it, with a large open sun outline appearing to the left of the canopy.

concept: Bed Beneath a Four-Pane Window
description: A side-view bed has a tall slanted headboard, small rounded pillow, and long mattress on straight legs. A square four-pane window hangs above the bed on the right.

concept: Single Bed with Tall Rounded Headboard
description: A side-view single bed has a tall rounded headboard on the left and a low footboard on the right. A raised pillow rests at the head above a long flat mattress.

concept: Ball Arcing Toward Three Party Cups
description: Three tapered cups form a triangular group, with one cup forward and two behind. A round ball hangs above the central gap, followed by two short curved flight trails.

concept: Oval Beetle with Six Bent Legs
description: A beetle has a broad oval shell split by a straight central seam. A small rounded head and two antennae sit above it, while three bent legs project from each side.

concept: Beveled L-Shaped Corner Join
description: A thick L-shaped outline turns through a clipped outer corner at the upper left. Thin interior guide lines meet at a small square marker beside the bend, following both arms of the shape.

concept: Round Puppy Head with Drooping Ears
description: A broad rounded puppy head has two long ears hanging down along its sides. Short vertical inner ear contours join the lower head curve, leaving the face otherwise empty.

concept: Bicycle Secured Beside a Parking Stand
description: A side-view bicycle has two round wheels joined by a triangular frame, with a small saddle and raised handlebars. A tall rounded parking stand overlaps the right-hand wheel.

concept: Bicycle Front with a Rear Trailer
description: A large front wheel and angled fork appear at the right beneath a short handlebar. A bent connecting frame leads leftward to a small enclosed trailer with one visible round wheel.

concept: Birdwatching Telescope Beneath Three Birds
description: A stepped telescope barrel angles upward to the right above three thin tripod legs. Three small V-shaped bird silhouettes spread across the open sky above the instrument.

concept: Bonfire Beside a Bare Grain Stalk
description: A large curved flame with a pointed inner notch rises above two crossed sticks. To its right, a tall stem carries several long upward-angled branches, creating a sparse grain-like silhouette.

concept: Upright Hand with Curled Fingers
description: A hand rises from a narrow wrist into a tall rounded upright finger. An adjacent bent finger curves inward to form a long teardrop-shaped opening within the hand's outline.

concept: Bull Head with Upturned Horns
description: A front-facing bull has a broad forehead, projecting side ears, and two curved horns rising above the head. Narrow slanted eyes sit above a long muzzle with paired nostril marks.

concept: Three Round Berries on a Leafy Stem
description: Three round berries overlap in a triangular cluster beneath a short branching stem. A single pointed leaf extends toward the upper right, with an open curved stem tip on the left.

concept: Rounded Birthday Cake with One Candle
description: A squat rounded cake has a wavy icing edge across its upper half. One upright candle stands centrally on top, with a detached teardrop flame above its flat upper edge.

concept: Trapezoidal Lamp with Three Light Streaks
description: A wide lamp body has straight top and bottom edges and a slanted right side. Three horizontal light streaks extend to its right, increasing in length from top to bottom.

concept: Cross-Topped Tower with a Hanging Bell
description: A pointed roof crowned by a small cross covers a tall open bell tower. A bell hangs from a short central stem inside, with a rounded clapper projecting below its flared rim.

concept: Soft Beret with a Short Top Stem
description: A broad soft beret slopes from a low rounded left side to a fuller right crown. Its curved lower edge sits above a straight narrow headband, with a short stem rising from the top.

concept: Three Angular Rocks in a Cluster
description: A tall irregular rock rises behind two shorter stones that lean inward from either side. Their shared edges form a small angular opening near the lower center above a short baseline.

concept: Curved Bay with Two Wave Lines
description: A broad rounded shoreline curves around a sheltered bay, with a deep inward bend near the upper right. Two short wavy lines lie inside the open coastal outline.

concept: Five Beads on a Sagging String
description: Five circular beads form a shallow U-shaped arrangement, with the middle bead lowest. Short links join the outer pairs, leaving small gaps beside the central bead.

concept: Small Pointy-Eared Creature
description: A round-headed creature has two tall pointed ears, tiny dot eyes, and a short mouth mark. Its squat body has two small outstretched arms and rounded feet separated by a shallow arch.

concept: Domed Cycling Helmet with Chin Strap
description: A broad low helmet dome has a straight lower rim. Beneath it, a rectangular strap section leads into a small circular fastener, with a narrow free end hanging downward.

concept: Rounded Tree with One Branch
description: A tall tree has a rounded crown narrowing into a smaller upper lobe. A straight trunk runs through the lower crown, with one short branch angling upward to the right.

concept: Diamond Pendant on a V-Shaped Chain
description: Two long diagonal chain lines meet above a suspended diamond-shaped pendant. A horizontal line divides the pendant into upper and lower triangles, and a short vertical attachment rises at the top.

concept: Domed Birdcage with a Central Perch
description: A tall domed cage stands on a broad rectangular base and has a round top knob. A central vertical bar meets a short horizontal perch inside the otherwise open enclosure.

concept: Blackberry Cluster with a Single Leaf
description: Several overlapping round drupelets form a tapered berry cluster. A short stem rises to one pointed leaf at the upper right, with a small curved stem tip extending leftward.

concept: Cargo Bicycle with a Deep Front Box
description: A side-view bicycle has a triangular rear frame on the left and a smaller front wheel on the right. A deep trapezoidal cargo box sits above the front wheel beneath tall handlebars.

concept: Pointed Beard with a Broad Mustache
description: A full beard tapers from high straight side edges to a pointed chin. A broad curved mustache sits across its upper interior, with a smooth lower contour and subtly notched upper edge.

concept: Wide Birdbath on a Pedestal
description: A broad shallow bowl has a straight rim and smoothly curved underside. A narrow central pedestal widens into a rounded foot, supporting the bowl above a flat base.

concept: Upright Stem with Three Leaves
description: A long straight stem carries three pointed leaves on short angled branches. One leaf extends left near the top, while two leaves project right at different heights.

concept: Hand Lowering a Coin Toward a Cup
description: A hand reaches from the upper left and pinches a round coin between curved fingers. The coin hangs just above a tapered cup with a broad open rim and rounded lower corners.

concept: Coin Passing Between Two Hands
description: An upper hand reaches down from the right while an open lower palm extends from the left. A small round coin floats in the gap between the fingertips and receiving palm.

concept: Index Finger Touching a Phone
description: A rounded upright phone stands behind a large hand with its index finger extended upward onto the screen. The thumb points diagonally left, while three curled fingers form the hand's upper-right edge.

concept: Barred Birdcage with a Round Top Knob
description: An upright cage has a domed roof rising into a small rounded knob. Several vertical bars curve over the dome and cross two horizontal rails above the flat bottom edge.

concept: Steaming Bathtub with a Curved Faucet
description: A broad tub has a flat rim, rounded lower corners, and two short splayed feet. A tall curved faucet rises on the right, while three curling steam strokes float above the basin.

concept: Plain Human Head in Left Profile
description: A smooth head outline curves around the skull and descends into the neck at right. A projecting nose, short horizontal mouth mark, and squared chin define the left-facing profile.

concept: Front-Facing Torso with a Rounded Belly
description: A headless torso has sloping shoulders, long outer arm contours, and a broad protruding abdomen. Short inner side lines curve inward above the belly, which closes in a rounded lower edge.

concept: Makeup Brush Touching a Cheek
description: A face appears in partial profile with a curved nose, parted lip contours, and rounded chin. A diagonal cosmetic brush approaches the cheek from the upper right, with a broad tapered bristle head.

concept: Smooth Bird Head with a Pointed Beak
description: A single flowing outline forms a rounded bird head facing right. The upper curve descends into a long triangular beak, while the lower edge sweeps back toward a tapered neck base.

concept: Cyclist Climbing a Sloping Path
description: A round-headed rider leans forward above two bicycle wheels at different heights. Bent arms reach toward the higher front wheel, and a straight ground line rises from lower left to upper right.

concept: Nested Trapezoidal Bucket Mark
description: A broad upright trapezoid narrows toward its lower edge. A smaller matching trapezoid sits centrally inside it, leaving a wide plain border between the two straight-sided outlines.

concept: Standing Beachgoer Beside Sun and Waves
description: A small round-headed person stands at left with arms lowered. To the right, a circular sun has short radiating rays above two parallel wavy water lines.

concept: Person Holding a Small Bowl
description: A round-headed figure has one arm bent across the lower torso, with the hand resting against a small rounded bowl. The opposite arm hangs straight beside the body's outer contour.

concept: Reclining Figure Beneath a Beach Umbrella
description: A round-headed figure reclines with bent knees beneath a broad semicircular umbrella. The umbrella's thin pole leans slightly, and a repeating curved wave line runs below the figure.

concept: Cyclist on a Fully Framed Bicycle
description: A round-headed rider leans forward with both arms reaching toward the handlebar. A triangular bicycle frame joins two large round wheels beneath the bent seated leg and straight front fork.

concept: Cyclist Above Two Open Wheels
description: A round-headed cyclist bends forward with rounded arms extending to a short handlebar. One leg hangs between two detached wheel circles, with a thin fork line entering the front wheel at right.

concept: Sleeper Beneath a Raised Blanket
description: A round head rests at the left end of a side-view bed. A long raised blanket contour covers the body to the right, above a straight mattress band and short supporting legs.

concept: Bather Sitting in a Rounded Tub
description: A round-headed person rises from the left side of a broad curved bathtub. One bent arm extends along the upper rim, while the tub's rounded body rests on a short flat base.

concept: Person Beside a Beach Bucket
description: A round-headed person stands with straight legs and arms lowered beside the torso. A small handled bucket sits to the left, with a wavy ground line crossing beneath both subjects.

concept: Low Bear Silhouette Facing Right
description: A broad bear silhouette faces right with a raised shoulder, long nearly level back, and rounded projecting muzzle. Two blocky legs descend beneath the body, separated by a deep squared belly opening.
